name: schedule-examples
summary: Copy-and-edit launchd and cron files that run a job and the deadman watcher that notices when the job stops.

env.HUBKIT_NOTIFY_CMD: optional, set it in the crontab (cron does not pass your shell's environment)

needs: macOS (launchd) or any system with cron (WSL2 Ubuntu on Windows 11 counts)
